name: Momentum
text: Every kill hands you 1 AP back.

name: Executioner
text: Hits on anything under half its HP do half again as much damage.

name: Bloodthirst
text: Heals you for a third of the damage it does.

name: Loaded Dice
text: You crit on a natural 17 or better, not 19.

name: Second Wind
text: Once a fight, the first time you drop under a quarter of your HP, you get a quarter of it back.

name: Electric Personality
text: Anything that hits you in melee takes 4 damage back.

name: Ox Heart
text: 15 more max HP, and 1 more HP back per room walked.

name: Scene Stealer
text: +3 CHA and +3 initiative. The cameras find you first.

name: Cockroach Constitution
text: +2 CON, and poison barely touches you.

name: Venom Glands
text: Every solid hit poisons. Every great hit poisons for longer.
